scenes.say: This man survived two atomic bombs.
In August 1945, engineer Tsutomu Yamaguchi was in Hiroshima on a business trip.
scenes.heading: AUGUST 6, 1945
scenes.sub: Tsutomu Yamaguchi, on a business trip

scenes.say: When the bomb exploded, he was badly burned. But he survived.
Days later, he made it back home, to Nagasaki.
scenes.heading: 3 DAYS LATER

scenes.say: He was telling his boss what one bomb had done to Hiroshima, when the second one exploded over Nagasaki.
scenes.heading: AUGUST 9, 1945

scenes.say: He survived again. And lived to be ninety-three.
He's the only person ever officially recognized as a survivor of both bombings. He spent his later years calling for an end to nuclear weapons.
scenes.heading: THE ONLY ONE
